classification.method: 30-criterion HCU narrative analysis; largest-remainder normalization to 100
classification.note: Provisional narrative coordinates, not measured human benefit, quality or physical probabilities.

rationale.HUMAN: Cemal's lived experience, caregiving, agency, fair pay and limited time anchor the conflict.
rationale.LIGHT: Evidence, testing, reviewer evaluation, risk-proportionate review and accountable coordination structure the response.
rationale.DARK: Unexplained temporal echoes, independent convergent projects, dissent and new experiments keep the inquiry open.

unmapped_elements: The metaphysical direction of thought and realization is not captured by narrative weights.
Human benefit across people and time is not reducible to one center score.
Correlated reviewer failures and domain expertise require engineering evaluation beyond narrative classification.
